proposed_contract.namespace: epistemic-trust-only; no BEACON relay or HOME issue reuse
proposed_contract.observation: Read-only optional EPISTEMIC_TRUST_WITNESS_V1 as frozen compatibility review, appended only after final diagnostic report and archive verified. No change to schedule, existing prompt, BEACON JSON, deduplication or relay policy. No extra task.
proposed_contract.anchor: Separate authority-owned store with write ACL excluding producer, authenticated source observation, independently retained highwater, atomic CAS against version and prior commitment, no overwrite/delete/force push permitted for producer. GitHub-only separate repo can reduce producer risk but does not establish global protection against shared privileged admins.
transition_rules: Missing prior anchor, source authorization or exact evidence => HOLD.
Lower version => ROLLBACK_HOLD; equal version different digest => CONFLICT_HOLD; equal version same digest => NOOP, not new cycle.

Next version exactly prior+1, parent digest equals prior commitment, distinct successful run and verified artifact bytes, valid signed external witness receipt and expected CAS token required before append.

Separate writer must atomically check expected prior commitment and append; reread exact committed record. No overwrite. Authentication, timestamp and protection policy need separate tests. Fail closed on stale CAS, fork, unavailable external witness or missing artifact.
